current.text: He is a rookie. The Lakers traded up one spot in the 2026 draft to select him.
In summer league he took almost 7 threes a game. He shot 42% FG, 29% on threes and 73% FT, and added little else.
Experts expect him to play 12 to 16 minutes and not to do much at first. He should not impact most leagues this season.
The two open Lakers starting spots are mainly between Grimes, LaRavia and Mamukelashvili. Ziaire Williams might also start.
One expert likes how he fits next to Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.

durable.text: He is a very long guard. In summer league he showed he can block shots, including jump shots.
Experts like his outlier athleticism and defensive skills. They see a guard who can hit threes, block shots and get steals, with upside as a shooter, passer and scorer.

note: Yahoo ranks him 653rd with a value of 0 USD, and ESPN gives him no rank. Our auction drafts 144 players, so he is not a draft target. His Yahoo projection of 9.2 points, 0.6 steals and 0.2 blocks fits the expected bench role of 12 to 16 minutes. Early in the season, check whether his minutes go above that range and whether the blocks and steals he showed in summer league carry over. Only then is he worth a waiver look.
